plugins.description: Skills, one per sprint phase, that read the sprint's Miro board, test every lock against the evidence, and write a report for the facilitator. Human creates. AI improves, tests, challenges, and guides. v0.1 ships sprint-setup and sprint-day1; the remaining phases follow.
